post.text:
So bullish on silver here.  

Built a position over last few months to hopefully hold/roll over next few years. As long as it holds $24.30

Loaded to the gills.

Sold a decent clip of Gold/Silver positions on Friday.  Left the miners alone.  First selling since taking positions in 2023.  

Sold without loss of a trend too, which I try not to do.  

But it’s just hard to ignore how extended its become. How much attention it suddenly has.

I rotated out of silver last week and into gold for accounts.  Hold miners though.

But the strength remains. Normally a blowoff top is quickly reversed and sharply lower.  This seems to be setting up for yet another leg higher.
